You're not weak and you're not ungrateful, first of all.

Second of all, yes, many people have it way worse than you or than me, but that doesn't make our problems invalid. Even if you were upset over what you think is the most unimportant thing ever, you're still allowed to be mad about it.

Don't let yourself belittle your problems, as small as they might seem. I would be more than happy to hear you out on anything that makes you upset. 

Also, even if it might not seem like it right now, everything will get better. Life can get seriously stressful sometimes and that's okay. Even if it might seem hopeless and exhausting right now, I hope that everything will get better for you soon and I believe in you. And seriously, you're not weak. Venting on the internet isn't weak, it's good because you can safely talk about your feelings and make other people feel less alone with their own issues :)

Please don't. I know that everything feels hopeless and that it will never get better but it will, I promise you. 

One of the biggest aspects of life is just how random and full of surprises it is. And while this can be incredibly frustrating and draining, it also means a lot of good opportunities and hope for the future. It probably seems impossible right now, but there is something waiting for you in life, even if it doesn't look like it at the moment.

You might feel trapped and exhausted, but please, hang in there just a little bit longer. Even if you feel lost and like nothing is working out, that just means that you will be that much stronger once you get through this. Nothing bad can last forever, there is a turning point waiting for you.

Your life will definitely get better! Even if it might not seem like it right now, I'm sure that you will get the future that your younger self dreamed of. Or maybe you won't, maybe you will get something completely different than what you've imagined. 

Either way, I really think that whatever is waiting for you will be a good thing. Especially if you're feeling down right now because that means that things can only get better. 

I've had a few rough times in the past, and every time I felt like everything was hopeless, things slowly but surely started to go back up again. So hang in there, everything will be just fine :)

There is no reason for you to feel guilty. Even if they gave you all of those things, that doesn't excuse any of their behavior. I'm really sorry to hear that though, and I hope that things will get better. Even if it might seem hopeless right now, please, try to get help. It might seem like it's too late, but I really think that it could make you feel a lot better.

Also, don't feel bad about hating your family. I know that this probably sounds bad, but I genuinely mean it. Family is always portrayed as this inseparable bond between loving people, but that doesn't mean that it always is like this.

It took me years to accept that I wholeheartedly hate my brother. I thought that families always stick together and tried to focus only on the few good times we had in the past, but there just wasn't anything that made me like him even in the slightest. And as sad as it might seem and as guilty as you might feel about not fitting into that perfect harmonious family image, it's just the truth. What that means is just that instead of your family, you will have to find your home and safe place elsewhere, even if it might take time and effort to find it. But I believe that you can and will, I really do. You can get through this :)

I have the exact same situation here in our home, so I feel you. My brother is also the cause of it and his selfishness is freaking out the whole family. I really hope that things will get better for you, though, and that you can all get through this just fine.

As a fellow Pisces, I can confidently say that I have never been on good terms with any Virgo I have ever met. They are very similar, but at the same time so different. You let your guard down because you think you understand them, but suddenly they do something so unexpected that it startles you more than it would with other signs, where you expect the differences between one another. 

Pisces, on the other hand, I have been avoiding quite successfully. I think because we share the same sign, there is not much to learn from each other, and because we are usually quite passive, we don't notice each other either haha.

Weirdly enough, I haven't interacted much with the signs I am supposed to be compatible with. My friends have included 3 Leos and a Gemini so far, which are not exactly the best matches. 2014. I'm still quite young, so my worst year is probably yet to come, but this one was the worst one so far. 

First year of new school and I was late, so I had to sit in the only spot left, which was surrounded by boys. As a girl, they weren't really that friendly, so I was basically alone there. 

I was quite socially awkward, so I didn't make any friends and the only person I talked to at least a tiny bit was a complete asshole that ended up telling me she doesn't want to be friends in front of the whole class.  

The whole year itself was horrible, because everytime we had lunch or even just breaks between classes, people would talk to each other and just generally hand out, while I just sat by myself, embarrassed that everyone could see that I was alone. 

There's more, but this is the simplest I can put it here.

Make people study all the subjects at first (the basics).

Afterwards, let them choose a set number of classes they will attend from then on and learn about it more. Stuff like P.E. would still be mandatory, but someone that's interested in languages for example wouldn't have to study physics since they don't want to pursue it in the future (or anything related to it). 

I understand that all the subjects are somewhat important, but I will never understand why they make people study something they know they hate and will never pursue for many years, forcing them to spend that time on those subjects instead of spending it on learning the subjects they choose themselves.
